# Anuj Patel — Applied AI & Backend Engineer

Anuj Patel (handle: byanujpatel) is an applied AI and backend engineer based in India. He builds LLM applications, FastAPI backends, AI agent workflows, RAG pipelines and full-stack MVPs, with a bias for shipping working products over slide decks.

## Projects

### Content Repurposing Engine
AI content engine. Creators waste hours adapting one idea for each platform; this turns docs, URLs and PDFs into ready-to-post drafts across platforms in under 10 seconds per run.
Stack: Python, FastAPI, LLMs, Streamlit.
Live: https://repurposemycontent.streamlit.app
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/content-repurposing-engine

### TrendChain AI
Crypto trend engine. Crypto creators need timely ideas from noisy live sources; TrendChain turns YouTube, Hacker News, CoinGecko and news into viral content ideas with live signals.
Stack: Python, LLMs, CoinGecko API, Hacker News API.
Live: https://crypto-trend-finder.streamlit.app
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/TrendChain-AI

### Health Label
Health decision app. Nutrition labels are hard to judge quickly; scan a barcode or label and get an instant health score.
Stack: Python, ML, external nutrition APIs, UX.
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/HealthLabel

## Technical skills
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, MERN.
Backend: Node, Express, FastAPI, REST APIs.
AI: LLM apps, agents, evals, RAG.
Shipping: observability, Vercel, GitHub, rapid MVPs.
